services.name: MongoDB Atlas
services.purpose: Primary database for contracts, users, organizations, audit logs
setup_steps: Create M0 Free Tier cluster (AWS, us-east-1 recommended)
Configure Network Access (0.0.0.0/0 for dev, specific IPs for prod)
Create Database User with read/write permissions
Get connection string from Connect > Drivers > Python

services.name: Emergent.sh
services.purpose: LLM API key for AI contract analysis, chat, and summarization
setup_steps: Sign up at emergent.sh with GitHub or email

services.name: Resend
setup_steps: Create API key with Full Access permission
For production: add and verify custom domain in Domains section
For development: use onboarding@resend.dev as from address

services.name: JWT Secret (Local Generation)
services.purpose: Signing JWT access tokens for authentication

services.name: CORS Configuration (Local)
services.purpose: Allowed frontend origins for cross-origin requests

services.name: AWS S3
services.purpose: Contract file uploads and document storage
setup_steps: Create S3 bucket with versioning enabled
Create IAM user with least-privilege policy for bucket
Generate access key for programmatic access
Set bucket name and region in env

services.name: OpenRouter
services.purpose: Alternative LLM access for OpenCode agents

commands: openssl rand -base64 48  # Generate JWT_SECRET - copy output
# Edit all three .env files with your values
cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn server:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
cd frontend && yarn install && yarn start
env_template:
# ===========================================
# DATABASE (MongoDB Atlas)
# ===========================================
MONGO_URL=mongodb+srv://lexisense_user:YOUR_PASSWORD@lexisense-cluster.xxxxx.mongodb.net/lexisense?retryWrites=true&w=majority
DB_NAME=lexisense

# ===========================================
# AUTHENTICATION
# ===========================================
JWT_SECRET=YOUR_GENERATED_48_CHAR_BASE64_SECRET
JWT_ALGORITHM=HS256
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=1440

# ===========================================
# CORS
# ===========================================
CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:3001

# ===========================================
# AI / LLM (Emergent.sh)
# ===========================================
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=emergent_your-actual-key

# ===========================================
# EMAIL (Resend.com)
# ===========================================
RESEND_API_KEY=re_your-resend-api-key
RESEND_FROM_EMAIL=LexiSense <onboarding@resend.dev>
RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_your-webhook-secret
APP_URL=http://localhost:3000

# ===========================================
# AWS S3 STORAGE (Optional)
# ===========================================
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=your-secret-access-key
AWS_S3_BUCKET=lexisense-files-prod
AWS_REGION=us-east-1

# ===========================================
# OBSERVABILITY (Optional)
# ===========================================
SENTRY_DSN=https://xxx@sentry.io/project
LOG_LEVEL=INFO
LOG_JSON=true
ENVIRONMENT=development
RELEASE_VERSION=2.0.0

# ===========================================
# OPENROUTER (Optional - for OpenCode agents)
# ===========================================
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-your-openrouter-key
